verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an API-based Terminal integration, a published OpenAPI spec, and specific Dashboard actions that are also available through the API, such as refunds. However, no evidence states that every Dashboard action (reader ordering, configuration, monitoring, dispute handling) can also be done through the API, so full parity is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or reference showing API coverage of all Dashboard reader-management and dispute features, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Terminal supports an API-based integration in addition to SDKs for Android, iOS, JavaScript, and React Native.
You can issue refunds by using the Refunds API or the Dashboard.
This repository contains OpenAPI specifications for Stripe's API.
the ability to fully integrate with the API on a terminal level is the most powerful thing here
